_comment.description: Sentinelas anomaly alert routing: Telegram + Gmail (OAuth2).
_comment.flow: Webhook -> Format/Enrich -> IF confidence>=0.6 -> Telegram(retry x3) -> Gmail(HTML, OAuth2) -> Slack(retry x3) -> Respond
changes_v2: Gmail node (OAuth2) replaces the SMTP emailSend node — no App Password involved.
Format node now validates the payload and computes severity bands (>=0.90 CRITICAL, >=0.75 HIGH, else MEDIUM).
Telegram body is rendered HTML with a severity accent; the email is a full HTML card.
Telegram node retries 3x on transient failures.
Respond reports real per-channel status (message_id / gmail id) instead of fields that never existed.
Added a third sink: Slack (message/post, mrkdwn) after Gmail, so all three channels fire from one alert.
credentials_required: Gmail node    -> gmailOAuth2Api credential (Google Cloud OAuth client id + secret, then Sign in with Google).
Slack node   -> slackApi credential (Bot User OAuth Token, xoxb-...). Channel: #sentinelas-alerts.
